_meta.name: aiadra-architecture-graph
_meta.purpose: On-demand visualization snapshot of the architecture described in ArchitectureOverview.md. The prose Overview is the master record; this graph is refreshed only when a visual rendering is wanted, and is expected to drift between refreshes. Authority hierarchy: ADRs > Manifesto > ArchitectureOverview > this graph.
_meta.format_note: Top-level uses addNodes / addEdges so the file imports into Buildpad (or any compatible tool) without transformation. Semantically these are 'the nodes and edges in the current graph', not a delta — they describe the full graph as of last_updated.
_meta.scope_note: Reflects the post-Ring-0 architecture as of 2026-05-17. Layer 3 (AI Action Protocol contract specifics) and Layer 5 (Domain Adapter contract specifics) are deferred to Rings 2-3; their nodes here are the surfaces that exist today, not their full eventual shape.

addNodes.label: Single AI-accessible product truth model
addNodes.description: One canonical, deterministic source of truth for every product fact (Objects, parameters, requirements, events, history, releases) — designed from the ground up for AI-agent access

addNodes.label: Probabilistic AI, deterministic core, human approval
addNodes.description: AI proposes and explains; rule-based core validates and records; humans gate every change. Probabilistic output and engineering record never mix

addNodes.label: No-HQ open-source posture
addNodes.description: AIADRA Core operates no service. Every project owns its truth, infrastructure, identity, and access control — any Git host, any Vault backend

addNodes.label: Engineer
addNodes.description: Mechanical / electrical / systems / software contributor working in a Workspace; authors and reviews changes

addNodes.label: Maintainer
addNodes.description: Reviews and approves ECRs/ECOs; cuts Releases; holds branch-protection authority on the project's Git host

addNodes.label: AI Agent
addNodes.description: First-class engineering participant per Manifesto. Acts only through the AI Action Protocol; never bypasses validation or human approval

addNodes.label: Maker / Hobbyist
addNodes.description: Tier-S solo user (e.g., 3D-printed enclosure project). Same machinery, smaller scope

addNodes.label: VSCode + AIADRA Extension
addNodes.description: Primary Workspace Browser. Inspect Objects, review AI proposals, open PRs, monitor validation, navigate where-used graph

addNodes.label: FreeCAD AIADRA Workbench
addNodes.description: Mechanical authoring surface. Modified FreeCAD that emits canonical Objects and Events through the Domain Adapter (Ring 3+, deferred)

addNodes.label: AIADRA CLI
addNodes.description: `aiadra migrate`, `aiadra validate`, `aiadra cache rebuild`, release-manifest generation. The deterministic-core surface

addNodes.label: AI Action Protocol API
addNodes.description: Structured contracts (inspect / query / propose / modify / validate / commit / release). Stable typed API — never natural-language scraping

addNodes.label: Git Host PR View
addNodes.description: Where ECR/ECO review happens. AIADRA reuses the host's PR interface (GitHub/Gitea/Forgejo/GitLab) instead of building its own

addNodes.label: Inspect & query truth
addNodes.description: Read Objects, parameters, requirements, where-used, release history. Locality-tier and staleness-tolerance aware per ADR/0001 §6

addNodes.label: Propose change (Transaction)
addNodes.description: Begin → modify named Parameter → recompute → validate → compare → human approval → commit-or-rollback. Failed Transactions leave no canonical trace

addNodes.label: Validate
addNodes.description: JSON Schema + AIADRA YAML Profile linter + sidecar/event invariant + bundle digest. Five hard-reject classes; one warn-on-read class. Runs locally

addNodes.label: Open ECR / Review ECO
addNodes.description: Push branch → open PR with impact analysis + validation results → maintainer review → merge to protected branch. Same path for AI and human authors

addNodes.label: Cut Release
addNodes.description: Generate deterministic JSON manifest: every UUID + Revision + artifact hash + validation outcome + approval signature. Content-hashable, signable

addNodes.label: Migrate schemas
addNodes.description: Explicit forward-migration of sidecars to a newer bundle. Deterministic, dry-run, idempotent, no-network, fixture-tested. Events stay immortal at their declared version

addNodes.label: Rebuild acceleration cache
addNodes.description: Deterministically reconstruct the local DuckDB index from canonical text. Safe at any time without data loss

addNodes.label: Sidecars
addNodes.description: Current authoritative Object state in AIADRA YAML Profile. One managed Object per file. Diffable in Git, validated at every read

addNodes.label: Event log
addNodes.description: Append-only JSONL stream of approved transitions and provenance. Each event immortal at its declared schema_version

addNodes.label: Release manifests
addNodes.description: Frozen, content-hashable, signable deterministic JSON records of each Release. Re-rendering at a new schema would invalidate the signature, so never migrated

addNodes.label: Vault blobs
addNodes.description: Binary artifacts (STEP, meshes, drawings, simulation outputs) referenced by content hash from the text layer. Lives in pluggable Vault backend

addNodes.label: Acceleration cache
addNodes.description: Per-clone derived DuckDB index for parametric and where-used queries. Never canonical, never shared, rebuildable from text artifacts

addNodes.label: Schema bundle pin
addNodes.description: Per-project .aiadra/schemas.yaml carrying bundle_version + bundle_digest (sha256 over canonical bundle serialization). Verified at startup and before every write

addNodes.label: Git host
addNodes.description: GitHub / Gitea / Forgejo / GitLab — any. Carries Commonspace; provides branch protection, PR review, signed tags. Project-chosen, not AIADRA-operated

addNodes.label: Vault backend
addNodes.description: GitHub LFS by default; S3 / MinIO / IPFS / NAS via Vault Adapter contract. Holds blob bytes only — no engineering decisions

addNodes.label: Domain Engines
addNodes.description: FreeCAD/OCCT (mechanical); KiCad planned (electrical); Git (software); procurement & DV adapters later. Modified to expose kernels natively, not wrapped

addNodes.label: AIADRA Core hosts nothing
addNodes.description: Principle 11. No AIADRA-operated service for storage, coordination, identity, or anything else. All inter-Workspace coordination resolves through Git mechanics

addNodes.label: Every AI action is a Transaction
addNodes.description: Principle 5. begin → validate → human approval → commit-or-rollback. Failed Transactions leave no canonical trace. No silent AI mutation

addNodes.label: Released truth is immutable
addNodes.description: Principle 8. Modifications require new Revision + ECR + impact analysis + approval. Old Releases remain readable forever (archival mode, ADR/0003 §6)

addNodes.label: UUID is identity; Number is presentation
addNodes.description: Principle 3. UUIDs are globally unique, opaque, never reused. Human-readable Numbers (P-000123) are stable presentation, allocated via Reservation file merged through Git

addNodes.label: Sidecar/event invariant
addNodes.description: ADR/0001 §4. If sidecars and events disagree, validation fails at commit — neither silently wins. Folding events forward must yield a state consistent with current sidecars

addNodes.label: schema_version mandatory; unknown versions hard-rejected
addNodes.description: ADR/0002 §4 + ADR/0003 §7. Every artifact declares its bundle version; validator refuses unrecognized bundles. Active authoring enforces deprecation horizon; archival mode keeps all historical bundles readable forever
